sn24.6:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.6:1.3: “karato kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācayato socato socāpayato kilamato kilamāpayato phandato phandāpayato pāṇamatipātayato adinnaṃ ādiyato sandhiṃ chindato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikaṃ karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato. paradāraṃ gacchato musā bhaṇato karoto na karīyati pāpaṃ,
sn24.6:1.4: khurapariyantena ce’pi cakkena yo imissā paṭhaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya, natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ. natthi pāpassa āgamo.
sn24.6:1.5: dakkhiṇañce’pi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto, pācento, natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo.
sn24.6:1.6: uttarañce’pi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yājento, natthi tato nidānaṃ puññaṃ, natthi puññassa āgamo.
sn24.6:1.7: dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena natthi puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo”ti.
sn24.6:2.1: “rūpaṃ kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati,
sn24.6:2.7: viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.6:3.4: api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya,
sn24.6:3.17: yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
sn24.6:3.18: aniccaṃ bhante …pe… yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ
sn24.6:3.19: api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya : “karato kārayato chindato chedāpayato pacato pācayato socato socayato kilamato kilamāpayato phandato phandāpayato pāṇamatipātayato adinnaṃ ādiyato sandhiṃ chindato nillopaṃ harato ekāgārikaṃ
sn24.6:3.20: karoto paripanthe tiṭṭhato paradāraṃ gacchato musā bhaṇato. karato na karīyati pāpaṃ, khurapariyantena cepi cakkena yo imissā paṭhaviyā pāṇe ekamaṃsakhalaṃ ekamaṃsapuñjaṃ kareyya natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ natthi pāpassa āgamo, dakkhiṇañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya hananto ghātento chindanto chedāpento pacanto pācento natthi tato nidānaṃ pāpaṃ, natthi pāpassa āgamo. uttarañcepi gaṅgāya tīraṃ gaccheyya dadanto dāpento yajanto yājento. natthi tato nidānaṃ puññaṃ natthi puññassa āgamo, dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena
sn24.6:4.1: yato kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa imesu chasu ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhasamudayepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhepissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāyapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti.
sn24.6:4.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
